description: This Java class 'MappingTimer' provides utilities for measuring execution time of mapping operations within a connectivity messaging context. It utilizes metrics and tracing tools to profile inbound and outbound message mappings, including payload and protocol segments.

classes.name: MappingTimer
classes.description: Helper class for creating timers that profile the duration of message mapping operations, both overall and segmented by payload and protocol.

methods.name: inbound
methods.description: Creates a MappingTimer instance configured for inbound message mapping timing, tagged with 'inbound' direction.

methods.name: outbound
methods.description: Creates a MappingTimer instance configured for outbound message mapping timing, tagged with 'outbound' direction.

methods.name: overall
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a runnable task, wrapping it with start/stop timing.

methods.name: overall
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a supplier task and returns its result, wrapping it with start/stop timing.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a supplier during payload processing, tagging it with the specified mapper.

methods.name: protocol
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a supplier during protocol processing.

methods.name: timed
methods.description: A helper method that runs a supplier and times its execution, handling success and failure tags.

methods.name: timed
methods.description: A helper method that runs a Runnable task and measures its execution time, handling success and failure tags.

methods.name: startNewTimer
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new expiring timer with appropriate tags for connection ID and type, with expiration handling.
